findings.title: Revenue growth
findings.summary: Revenue grew from $800M in the year ended 2023-06-30 to $1,200M in FY2025, a compound annual growth rate of 22.5% over 2 years.
details: Revenue increased in 2 of 2 year-over-year comparisons.
Growth in FY2025 (+20.0%) was below the 2-year compound rate (22.5%).
findings.method: Direction comes from the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) between the first and last year: above +1% a year is increasing, below −1% a year is decreasing, otherwise stable. When CAGR is not meaningful (a negative value at either end, such as a net loss), the direction follows the sign of the total change instead. Changes are calculated from unrounded values, so they can differ by 0.1 from the difference between the rounded figures shown.

findings.title: Margins
findings.summary: Margins moved in different directions between the year ended 2023-06-30 and FY2025.
details: Gross margin expanded, from 40.0% to 42.5% (+2.5 pp).
Operating margin expanded, from 15.0% to 17.5% (+2.5 pp).
Net margin was stable, from 10.0% to 10.8% (+0.8 pp).
findings.method: Each margin is compared between the first and last year. A change of more than +1 percentage point is expansion, less than −1 point is contraction, otherwise stable. The overall direction is mixed when the margins moved differently. Changes are calculated from unrounded values, so they can differ by 0.1 from the difference between the rounded figures shown.

findings.title: Working capital
findings.summary: Working capital increased, from $200M at the end of the year ended 2023-06-30 to $300M at the end of FY2025 (+$100M).
details: The current ratio went from 1.50x to 1.60x.
findings.method: Working capital = current assets − current liabilities, calculated for each year-end. A change smaller than 1% of the last year's revenue counts as stable; otherwise the direction follows the sign of the change. Without revenue, any change counts. Changes are calculated from unrounded values, so they can differ by 0.1 from the difference between the rounded figures shown.
